raw_text: Thread: What if China tried to take Arunachal Pradesh? My armchair general analysis in 15 tweets. 1/ The terrain is incredibly hostile for any mechanized invasion. 2/ PLA would need massive logistics buildup visible months in advance. 3/ India's Mountain Strike Corps was literally designed for this scenario. This is a thought experiment, not a prediction.
